candidate: Represent a bit vector by a subset product of pairwise coprime integer atoms; evaluate AND/OR/XOR/NOT using gcd, multiplication and exact division
repair: Multiply representations by a nuisance factor coprime to the public universe product P; normalize with gcd(value,P)
novelty_status: Divisor Boolean algebra is established; no independent new principle claimed. Only a bounded dismissal test, no backend expansion
attacker: Receives width, public P and chosen-input encoder observations for binary labels of bit positions, but no atom list, factorization, generator seed or challenge plaintexts
primary: Recover every bit-position atom without prime factorization, then decode held-out operation results
inputs: All 16x16 pairs at width4; 8x8 boundary pairs and 256 deterministic random pairs at width32
decision: Reject if basis recovery succeeds or if an independent technical principle is absent; no SHA/Wasm or performance expansion
controls: pairwise non-coprime atoms break the Boolean interpretation
decoder must reject an incomplete atom in an invalid representation
